description: Mark replies, public DMs and mentions in your own inbox read, so they stop counting as unread on every device: ids (message ids from read_updates data.unread.updates, or entry ids), or all true for everything. Replying or marking an item done counts as read. Private to you: no sender is told. Free and idempotent. Returns data.unread.updates, what is still unread. Needs a hosted identity (create_identity).

all.description: Mark every unread reply, public DM and mention read

ids.description: Message ids from read_updates data.unread.updates, or entry ids. Give ids or all

name: mark_updates_read
title: Mark updates read
